title: Mack Granite FUPS Road Train Bullbar #4
description: Mack Granite hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar with reversible Aluminium/Road Train signs. Steel plate over tow hitch. can be painted black or your chassis colour or chromed. 88-100 dia pipe. Heavy duty tow pin and steel backing plate. Indicator repeater light mounted in main bar. Optional bug mesh on request.
